entities.name: Volodymyr Butkevych
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Volodymyr Hryhorovych Butkevych (Boutkevich) is a Ukrainian scholar and human rights lawyer. From 1996 until 2008 he was the Ukrainian judge at the European Court of Human Rights.
